description: This file implements the operation functions for the Ansc CoVer3 object, including spawning tasks with different parameters and the engine task entry point, managing task creation and cleanup within the object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3SpawnTask(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * pTaskEntry,ANSC_HANDLE hTaskContext,char * name)
methods.description: Spawns a task with a specified task entry point, context, and name, managing internal task info list and incrementing the task count upon success.

methods.description: Spawns a task with specified task entry, context, name, and priority, managing internal task info list and task count.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3SpawnTask3(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * pTaskEntry,ANSC_HANDLE hTaskContext,char * name,int priority,ULONG stack_size)
methods.description: Spawns a task with specified entry point, context, name, priority, and stack size, updating internal task info list and count.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3EngineTask(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: The main entry point for each spawned task, which executes task routines from the internal list until shutdown.
